label: FIXTURE RESULT: Stage 5 evaluation (recorded window, frozen bundle)

attempts.validity: deciding source logs PARTIAL; durable backlog peak 236

A.rule: throughput shortfall without a slow consumer component

report.summary: Outbox publication fell behind arrivals, so notifications are delayed. Delivery logs and consumer timings are unavailable, so the cause of the slowdown is not identified.

findings.claim: Outbox publications lag arrivals: 470 published vs 592 arrived (122 gap), and pending grew from 1 to a peak of 236.
findings.reason: Durable counts and the pending gauge show a growing backlog that matches late notifications.

findings.claim: Publication rate dropped to about 7-8 per 10 s from the 7th bucket on, while arrivals were 22 per 10 s; the end-of-window buckets (77, 81) look like catch-up.
findings.reason: Per-bucket counts show a sustained throughput collapse and a late burst.

findings.claim: The transfers API is healthy (no 5xx, p99 0.25 s) and the DB pool is not saturated, so the delay is in outbox delivery and not in request handling or pool exhaustion.
findings.reason: Zero server errors, low latency, zero acquisition timeouts, and zero pending borrowers.

findings.claim: A stale backlog exists: 1034 FAILED entries stay constant, and the oldest undelivered age is about 46000 s, which began before the window.
findings.reason: The failed count is flat at 1034 and the oldest age grows steadily from 46000 s.

limitations: Delivery logs and timings are PARTIAL with 0 attempt records, so per-attempt outcomes and latencies are unknown.
Blocker sampling was UNAVAILABLE, so DB blocking cannot be ruled out.
E3 (search_delivery_logs) is PARTIAL: The collector has not yet confirmed reading the ledgercore log past the window end; recent records may be missing.
E4 (get_delivery_timings) is PARTIAL: The collector has not yet confirmed reading the ledgercore log past the window end; recent records may be missing.
E6 (get_database_blockers) is UNAVAILABLE: Blocking is sampled every 2 s: shorter blocks can be missed, and no blocking in the samples is not proof that no session waited.
next_checks: Re-collect delivery logs and timings once the collector has read past the window end, and check outcomes and durations of delivery attempts.
Check the consumer at 127.0.0.1:18090/events for latency, auth errors and handler time; inspect why 1034 entries are FAILED.

alternatives.hypothesis: The consumer endpoint (127.0.0.1:18090/events) is slow or failing, throttling the 3 s-timeout deliveries.
